title_sq: Te Komuna E Parisit, Shitet Bar-Kafe Perfekte Per Investim !!
description_sq: Te Komuna e Parisit, rruga Bilal Golemi, prane shkolles Fenis, shitet ambient biznesi bar-kafe totalisht i mobiluar dhe investuar, aktualisht i dhene me qera ne vleren 600 Euro/neto. Ambienti ndodhet ne katin 0 te nje pallati 10 katesh. Ambienti eshte nje mundesi mjaft e mire investimi pasi zona ne fjale eshte nje nder zonat me te populluara dhe me te kerkuara te qytetit te tiranes gjithashtu dyqani ka nje klientele te ngritur prej vitesh. Lokali shitet totalisht i mobiluar sic eshte dhe eshte i pajisur me dokumentacion te plote hipotekor.
title_en: In the Municipality of Paris, Perfect Bar-Cafe for Investment!!
description_en: In the Municipality of Paris, Bilal Golemi street, near the Fenis school, a fully furnished and invested bar-cafe business premises is for sale, currently rented at the value of 600 Euro/net. The environment is located on the 0th floor of a 10-story building. The environment is a very good investment opportunity, since the area in question is one of the most populated and sought-after areas of the city of Tirana, and the store has an established clientele for years. The premises are sold fully furnished as is and equipped with full mortgage documentation.
